name: sexyAmole-agent-muster
description: Agent Muster brings Codex, Claude Code, Pi, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, and more into one desktop or local-web workspace. Manage projects and sessions with multi-pane layouts, file/Git/terminal side panels, image and file references, and automate tasks via DingTalk, Feishu, WeCom, and WeChat bots.
